lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is observed posterior to the gill slits. These clusters are arranged in approximately four visible horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns, with inter-blob spacing varying between two and four blob-diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with faint horizontal bands across the mid-lateral flank, creating a rectangular grid where the highest-intensity blobs are centered at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a dense, stochastic distribution of smaller high-luminance blobs that lack the organized grid structure observed on the lateral flank.
